literal_meaning: হাড় এবং গোড় ভাঙা (breaking bones and joints)
figurative_meaning_en: To render someone immobile or incapacitated by severe beating
similar_in_english: Break every bone in one's body
example_sentences_in_bangla: শত্রুরা তাকে হাড়গোড় ভাঙা পর্যন্ত মারধর করল।
example_sentences_in_english: The enemies beat him until they broke his bones and joints.
If you don't listen, I'll beat you senseless.
note: This idiom vividly describes extreme physical punishment, common in rural Bengali storytelling and threats.
